title: Showtime
notes: Build your own setlist: it's rated on flow, opener, a ballad in the middle and a big closer, and a great one makes every show better.
Tiered tickets (general, reserved, VIP) with your manager's suggested prices, a percent-sold meter and how fans feel about the price, for shows and tours.
Playing the Grand Ole Opry now opens with a cutscene: backstage, the wings, the circle of wood, the announcer.
New: the Bluebird hush, a listening-room game where you keep the room silent.
The Ryman has stories to tell if you keep playing there.
Each week opens with 'Previously on Nashville', and every season finale has a song of the season montage.
Songs are about someone now, and they hear them. Co-writers suggest lines and react to your choices.
The rumour mill: what you do spreads around town until it reaches the wrong person, unless you get there first.
Playing Rayna or Deacon, raise Maddie and Daphne and perform a family number.
The Nashies ship your relationships, and road songs come to you on tour.
More moments from the show: 'Wrong Song', the elevator, Juliette's on-stage apology, Deacon's proposal and the family at the Opry. Rayna now starts as an Opry member.
